title: Normalized units boundary of a square-zero thickening
statement: Let $j:Z\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] that is a first order thickening [def-sbc-first-order-thickening], and let $I=j.\ker$ be its quasi-coherent defining ideal, viewed as an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Let $u_j:\mathcal O_X^\times\to j_*\mathcal O_Z^\times$ be restriction of units [def-sc-zariski-units-restriction], and let $K=\ker(u_j)$ in abelian sheaves. Define $S_j=(K\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X^\times\xrightarrow{u_j}j_*\mathcal O_Z^\times)$. This sequence is short exact. There is a unique isomorphism $e:I_{\rm ab}\xrightarrow{\sim}K$ such that, on every open $U\subset X$, the underlying unit of $e(a)$ is $1+a$, where $a$ is mapped into $\mathcal O_X(U)$ by the ideal inclusion. Use this uniquely normalized isomorphism. Define the Yoneda boundary $H^1(X,j_*\mathcal O_Z^\times)\to H^2(X,K)$ of $S_j$ and the induced map $H^2(e^{-1}):H^2(X,K)\to H^2(X,I_{\rm ab})$, in abelian-sheaf cohomology [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology].
